education.degree: MEng Mechanical Engineering with Minor in Intelligent Systems
awards: Frederic Barnes Waldron Best Student Award (2025): Awarded for the highest overall year average across all years of all undergraduate programmes.

keyModules: Year 1: Engineering Challenges, Mathematical Modelling and Analysis I, Design and Professional Skills I, Introduction to Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering Practical Skills I, Introduction to Thermodynamics and Fluid Mechanics, Engineering Dynamics, Fundamentals of Materials I

Year 2: Intelligent Systems, Mathematical Modelling and Analysis II, Manufacturing and Design, Control and Instrumentation, Intermediate Thermodynamics and Fluid Mechanics, Mechanics of Solids and Structures, Engineering Materials: Failures and Design, Design and Professional Skills II
education.longDescription: MEng Mechanical Engineering with a Minor in Intelligent Systems, on track for First Class Honours with year averages of 87.70% and 84.56%. Ranked top of the cohort in both years, earning the Frederic Barnes Waldron Best Student Award — for the highest year average across all UCL undergraduate programmes — alongside the Goldsmid Prize and Best Student in Mechanical Engineering.

MECENG C180: Engineering Analysis using the Finite Element Method (Grade A+)
ENGIN 125: Engineering, Ethics and Society (Grade A+)
education.longDescription: Selected for the UCEAP Reciprocity exchange at UC Berkeley, deepening my core in materials and structures: composite materials, FEA, and mechanical behaviour of materials, alongside thermal systems and dynamics. Complemented coursework with research at the FLOW Lab, completing the year with a 4.00 GPA.

awards: IELTS Overall Band Score 8.5 (Listening: 9.0, Reading: 9.0, Speaking: 8.5, Writing: 8.0)
education.longDescription: 4A* in CAIE A-Levels (Mathematics 98%, Physics 97%, Chemistry 95%, Further Mathematics 94%) while serving as Vice President of the Engineering Society and organising TEDx@KYUEM.
